bio: In this tiny – perhaps even the smallest – restaurant in Berlin, authentic sushi is served in a minimalist setting as an affordably priced omakase menu. The nigiri are the highlight: crafted with excellent ingredients and impressive skill by the owner, who prepares them right before your eyes and presents them himself from behind the simple wooden counter. There are three seatings: 1pm, 5pm and 8pm. N.B. The restaurant is somewhat hidden inside a building directly at Nordbahnhof that also houses an organic supermarket....
